artboards.title: Option B — one plate along the bottom

annotations.text: Option A, picked by the owner 2026-09-16. Half scale over the shipped screenshot. Full-scale geometry for the build: 'you' card at (24,24) 472×168, 'outside' card right-aligned 496×200, both with ui/chrome.gd's 40px header and 14px brackets; text 26px on 34px lines, first 'you' line in the player colour; action bar 1296×48 centred above the quick strip, E/T keys in accent, verbs in khaki, the key hint at 20px dim in its tail. The two HUD arrays stay exactly what check_hud reads; headers are chrome, not lines.
Option B — one plate. Not chosen. Most map visible; long sentences wrap badly in a third of a bar.
Option C — brackets only. Not chosen. Closest to today; little legibility gain over busy tiles.
